selection_role: Qualitative desk review only; no effect on numeric shortlist or recommendation rule. Historical anchors copied during current screening, before fresh confirmation.
rubric: Inspect shared topic or grammatical function, intrusive members, excessive breadth, loss of useful neighbors through fragmentation, and polysemy. Describe usefulness with concrete members. Do not turn spot-checks into an estimated semantic accuracy rate. No learner validation or independent benchmark is available.
